comments.body:
I will take this issue. Please assign it to me.

The crash seems to occur in the `event_loop_overlap_disagg_decode` function within `decode.py`. The traceback suggests an issue with the `forward_batch_generation` method in `eagle_worker_v2.py`. I would start by examining the inputs and outputs of `draft` and `draft_forward` methods. I will add logging to verify the batch data and ensure that the `draft_worker` is functioning as expected. Then, I will test a small fix to handle any unexpected input or state in these methods.

title: [Bug] GLM-5.3 crash on disagg decode + dp-attention + spec decode
